proposal.label: needs reproducible example
proposal.comment: Could you share the `tools/pythonpkg/pyproject.toml` (or `setup.py`) from the repository and the complete pip build output that includes the `ModuleNotFoundError` stack? Also confirm the `pip`/`setuptools` versions (`pip --version` and `python -c "import setuptools; print(setuptools.__version__)"`) and whether you built inside a virtualenv. This will show the declared build backend and the exact build-time environment needed to reproduce the missing `package_build` module error.
proposal.rationale: The build is failing with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'package_build'`, which indicates the Python build backend or build-time environment is missing or not declared. The report omits the package's build metadata (`pyproject.toml`/`setup.py`) and the full pip/setuptools versions and complete build log needed to reproduce and diagnose why the backend module is unavailable.
